plan: Given my private value of $20, I should bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while ensuring a win. Bidding exactly my value or higher risks no profit. Rational bidders will bid below their own values, anticipating the same from others. Thus, I will bid slightly below $20 to outbid others likely bidding below their values. This strategy balances winning the auction and maximizing profit.

My value is $31, which exceeds the maximum possible value of $20, indicating a potential error. Assuming a maximum value of $20, I should bid slightly above the expected average bid to win. Assuming rational bidders bid close to their values, I'll bid $20.1 to ensure winning while maximizing profit, given the second-highest bid will likely be close to $20.

Given my value of $12, I should bid slightly below this to ensure a profit if I win. Since rational bidders will bid up to their value, I aim to bid slightly below $12 to avoid overpaying. A bid of $11.5 maximizes potential profit while being competitive.
